results.name: Crystals debut in Level 4 wave 3 with their hint, one per color asked for, and come back in W5, W7 and W9
The launcher and tray show the seed colors from Level 4 only, and typeAhead(0) is the seed in the launcher
A seed of another color glances off with chroma:guard and no refund; the right color opens it
A match pays exactly one sun charge above a plain credited bloom, and the same score
A chain, a power or an uncredited strike opens it plainly whatever the color; a script never meets a guard
A crystal is a real piece: one reaching the line costs a life
The bot shoots a crystal only with its own color (+10, more as it nears the line), never with another (-1)
A crystal wave plays out the same at 30, 60 and 144 FPS
Bats debut in Level 4 wave 4 with their hint, and come back in W8 and W9
A bat perches 1.8 s (falling), tells for .8 s (still, arc drawn), swoops from 2.6 to 3.6 s and lands on its arc's end
A credited seed on a perched bat cracks it and startles it: a .25 s tell, its arc set on the same tick
A credited seed mid-swoop is a catch: it blooms, pays round(300 x tempo) and one sun charge, "bat:catch"
With every landing spot taken a bat stays perched another 1.8 s, and goes once one frees up
The two L4 W4 bats never start a swoop on the same tick, and land at least 30 px apart
The bot forecast matches the live bat within 1e-6 over 90 steps, from the tell and from mid-swoop
A Lullaby freezes a swoop where it is, and it carries on after
Bats play out the same at 30, 60 and 144 FPS, aimed shots and all
foes.js never touches the seed pod and never uses Math.random
Crystal and bat art: finite, balanced, nothing new once warm, and still under reduced motion
